lock.that_passkey_couldn_t_be: That passkey couldn’t be checked. Use the password instead.

delete.warning: Deleting "{name}" removes its settings, history, mistakes, saved texts and level from this browser. It can't be undone.
delete.last_step: Last step: "{name}" will be deleted now.

guest.saved_banner: Saved: this is "{name}" now, with everything you did as a guest. A password and backups can be set up in profile settings.

folder_restore.things_saved: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} kalibre saved.

folder_restore.the_folder_s_kalibre_json: The folder’s kalibre.json is damaged, so it can’t be read. Its files can still be imported one by one.

guest_banner.your_tests_mistakes_stats_and: Your tests, mistakes, stats and XP are kept in this browser, but not backed up, and the profile can’t be locked. Save your progress to keep it as your own profile.
guest_banner.you_re_trying_kalibre_as: You’re trying Kalibre as a guest.
guest_banner.this_browser_isn_t_keeping: this browser isn’t keeping anything, so nothing is saved when this window closes. to keep what you do, download your profile and load it in a normal window.

profile_edit_panel.passwords_need_a_secure_connection: Passwords need a secure connection (https:// or localhost), so they are not available here.
profile_edit_panel.this_is_a_guest_profile: This is a guest profile. Save your progress first (the banner at the top of the page), then add a password or passkey here.
profile_edit_panel.no_password_anyone_using_this: No password: anyone using this browser can open this profile.
profile_edit_panel.password_saved_the_profile_asks: password saved; the profile asks for it when Kalibre opens
profile_edit_panel.this_browser_can_t_use: This browser can't use passkeys here (they need https:// or localhost).
profile_edit_panel.set_a_password_first_then: Set a password first, then add a passkey to unlock with Touch ID, Windows Hello, a phone or a security key.
profile_edit_panel.no_passkeys_yet_a_passkey: No passkeys yet. A passkey unlocks this profile without typing the password.
profile_edit_panel.passkey_added_the_lock_screen: passkey added; the lock screen offers it next time
profile_edit_panel.the_only_profile_can_t: the only profile can't be deleted
profile_edit_panel.type_the_profile_name_exactly: Type the profile name exactly to confirm.
profile_edit_panel.this_profile_is_locked_so: this profile is locked, so confirm it's you.
profile_edit_panel.a_password_or_passkey_keeps: A password or passkey keeps other people using this browser out of Kalibre's screens. It doesn't encrypt what's stored in the browser.
profile_edit_panel.an_export_is_a_compressed: An export is a compressed .kalibre-profile file with this profile's history. Its password and passkeys come along as locks, but compressed isn't encrypted, so keep it somewhere private.
profile_edit_panel.removes_passkeys: This also removes {count, plural, one {its passkey} other {its # passkeys}}.

profile_form_helpers.optional_shrunk_to_a_small: Optional. Shrunk to a small square and kept in this browser.

profile_import.added_alongside_the_others_nothing: added alongside the others; nothing is overwritten

setup.just_try_it_as_a: just try it, as a guest

setup.progress_keys: · enter to continue · esc to skip
setup.keep_an_automatic_backup_in: keep an automatic backup in a folder on this computer? (the browser can clear its own storage)
setup.save_a_backup_of_this: save a backup of this profile to “{name}” now?
setup.who_ll_guide_your_touch: who’ll guide your touch typing lessons?
setup.new_here_or_been_here: new here, or been here before?
setup.kalibre_works_better_with_a: kalibre works better with a keyboard
setup.capital_letters_in_common_words: capital letters in common words? (quotes and your own texts always keep theirs)
setup.when_should_kalibre_suggest_a: when should kalibre suggest a mistake to train?
setup.automatically_start_training_mistakes_wh: automatically start training mistakes when they're ready?
setup.how_often_should_the_backup: how often should the backup folder be updated? (settings → data)
setup.name_hint: a nickname is best: leave out your real name and anything personal.
setup.starter_library_note: a starter library of public-domain books comes with kalibre, so tests are ready with nothing to download
setup.companion_note: they stay with this profile. To meet the other one, make another profile.
setup.restore_note: kalibre can bring back your profiles, datasets and fonts from the folder it saved them to.
setup.keyboard_note: the on-screen keyboard works for tests and games, but a bluetooth or usb keyboard makes them fairer, and the touch typing lessons really need one. kalibre works best on a computer.
setup.keyboard_tip: tip: add kalibre to your home screen (share → add to home screen) so safari keeps your data; in a tab, come back at least once a week.
